d:
We speak with neurologist Dr. Sid Warrier to understand why sexual content can become addictive, how constant exposure to highly stimulating content may affect our expectations of pleasure and relationships, and why short-form content can be particularly concerning for younger users.
Watch till the end for the full conversation and understand the darker side of social media.
